description: Look up and invoke InDesign menu actions: search the menu actions by name or area (id, title, area, enabled, checked), read one by id, invoke one by id when it is enabled and opens no dialog, or convert between localised UI strings and language-independent $ID/ key strings (Application.menuActions, findKeyStrings, translateKeyString)

areaContains.description: For search: text in the area, such as "Panel Menus:Layers" (case-insensitive)

id.description: For get and invoke: the menu action id

maxResults.description: For search: the most actions to return

nameContains.description: For search: text in the action name (case-insensitive)

text.description: For find_key_strings: a localised string; for translate_key_string: a $ID/ key string

name: run_menu_action
title: Run Menu Action
